player_prompt.intro: O n ṣere Mastermind. O nilo lati wa koodu ti o jẹ {code_length} awọn nọmba gigun, nọmba kọọkan lati 1 si {num_numbers}, {repeats}. Ninu idahun rẹ, o le fi ero rẹ ranṣẹ ni ọna kika atẹle: '[2 1 4 5]'. Lẹhin igbiyanju kọọkan, iwọ yoo gba esi ni irisi awọn agbọn dudu ati funfun. A dudu agbọn tọka si nọmba ti o tọ ni ipo ti o tọ, lakoko ti agbọn funfun kan tọka si nọmba ti o tọ ni ipo ti ko tọ. O ni {max_turns} yipada lati ṣe idanimọ koodu naa.
player_prompt.with_repeats: pẹ̀lú àwọn àtúnṣe tó ṣeé ṣe

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with a space-separated list of numbers wrapped in square brackets.
invalid_move.not_integers: All entries must be valid integers.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ìmọ̀ náà ní láti ní àwọn nọ́ńbà {code_length} pàtó.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Gbogbo iye gbọdọ wa laarin 1 ati {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: A kò gba àwọn nọ́ńbà méjì láyè.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: O ti mọ {guess}. Jọwọ gbiyanju idanwo miiran.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: O ti tú kódì, tí o yanjú {black_pegs} kúrò nínú {code_length} àwọn ìdìpọ̀ náà lóòtọ́
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached. You guessed {percent} percent of the numbers correctly.
